Population increased in Welwyn Hatfield

The estimated population of Welwyn Hatfield in 2024 was 122,819 usual residents, a rise of 0.9% since 2023.

This meant that Welwyn Hatfield's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Welwyn Hatfield increased by 2.6%.

Over this slightly longer period, Welwyn Hatfield was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Welwyn Hatfield

The average (median) age rose to 38.2 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Welwyn Hatfield has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Welwyn Hatfield is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Welwyn Hatfield's population of 122,819 usual residents was made up of:

  • 22,922 people aged 0 to 15 years, (18.7%)
  • 80,002 people aged 16 to 64 years, (65.1%)
  • 19,895 people aged 65 years and over, (16.2%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Welwyn Hatfield has a slightly lower proportion of people aged 65 years and over (16.2% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Welwyn Hatfield, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Welwyn Hatfield
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Welwyn Hatfield, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 238 people (0.2%). In total, there were 1,187 births and 949 deaths in Welwyn Hatfield.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) led to a fall in the population of 2,564 (-2.1%). There were 9,162 people entering the area and 11,726 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Welwyn Hatfield's population of 3,488 (2.9%) as a result of 5,299 people entering the area and 1,811 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Welwyn Hatfield was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Welwyn Hatfield in mid-2023 is 121,668.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 218 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 299 people.

Overall, there was an revision downwards of 81 people.
